scenarios.title: Hard Hat Missing
scenarios.summary: Ask whether a clearly visible person is missing a hard hat, then inspect the matching evidence and incident report.

rule.name: Hard Hat Missing
rule.prompt: Is a person standing or walking in the aisle clearly visible without a hard hat? Answer only Yes or No. Do not infer a missing hard hat when the person’s head is obscured.

steps.title: Ask an English-language question
steps.instruction: Choose Camera_01, name the rule, and enter the hard-hat question. Captured screens and results must be supplied by the complete demo package.

steps.title: Review the active camera rule
steps.instruction: The real recorded UI confirms which camera and prompt were saved. This source example has no captured result.

steps.title: Find a matching incident
steps.instruction: In the completed package, inspect the captured alert associated with this camera and rule.

steps.title: Review the recorded evidence
steps.instruction: Play the matching captured MP4. No evidence video is included in this source-only example.

steps.title: Open the incident-bound report
steps.instruction: The completed package links the report captured for the same incident and video interval.

steps.title: Keep the same incident in context
steps.instruction: Explore only the answers captured during the demonstrated report conversation.

followups.question: What color clothes is the person without a hard hat wearing?

scenarios.title: Forklift and Person Alert
scenarios.summary: Describe a person near a forklift, inspect the matching clip, and explore the captured observations about visible clothing.

rule.name: Forklift and Person Alert
rule.prompt: Is a person visibly walking close to a forklift in the same warehouse aisle? Start with Yes or No, then describe the visible activity in one short sentence.

steps.title: Describe the interaction to watch for
steps.instruction: Choose the unnumbered Camera and enter the recorded English-language rule. This is not an all-camera selection.

steps.title: Review the saved rule
steps.instruction: The completed package shows the actual saved prompt and selected camera.

steps.title: Inspect the captured alert
steps.instruction: Use the incident camera and time to connect the alert with its recorded evidence.

steps.title: See what happened in the aisle
steps.instruction: Play the saved incident MP4 when it is included in the package. Proximity alone does not establish danger.

steps.title: Open the corresponding report
steps.instruction: The report and playback should refer to the same camera, incident and UTC interval.

steps.title: Explore captured observations
steps.instruction: Select a recorded question about clothing and visible protective equipment. The walkthrough does not generate new answers.

followups.question: What is the person walking past the forklift wearing? Is a high-visibility vest or hard hat clearly visible?
Is anyone else wearing a high-visibility vest or hard hat? Describe their clothing and position.
